headline: Earnings jump on regulatory recovery; guidance reiterated
summary_short: CenterPoint Energy reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $2,152M (+10.7% y/y) and net income of $244M (+23.2% y/y), with GAAP diluted EPS of $0.37 (+23.3% y/y) and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.40 (+37.9% y/y); the company reiterated its FY2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance of at least the midpoint of its $1.89-$1.91 range.
summary_long: Growth and regulatory recovery added $0.10/share versus Q2 2025 and O&M savings added $0.02/share, partly offset by unfavorable weather/usage (-$0.01/share) and higher interest expense (-$0.01/share). EBITDA rose 22.6% y/y to $1,003M and operating income rose 28.1% y/y to $534M. CenterPoint reiterated FY2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance of at least the midpoint of $1.89-$1.91 (about 8% growth over 2025) and raised its 10-year capital plan by $1.2B to $66.7B (2026-2035) on accelerating Houston large-load demand, citing over 17GW of ERCOT Batch Zero submissions with ~14GW seen eligible as base or studied load.
